title: Chosen pullback comparison counit normalization
statement: Fix the unbounded derived categories of O-module sheaves on every scheme [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X→Y and g:Y→Z be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], and K a homotopy complex of O_X-modules. Write T(s) and U(s) for homotopy tensor pullback and direct image; b(s) for the homotopy adjunction induced by the choice in [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]; epsilon(s) for the selected left-derived counit in [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]; beta(s) for the recorded right-derived unit [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]; and a(s) for the pinned derived adjunction [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction, def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Put H=U(f)K and M=U(g)H. Let p be the fixed comparison, named by [lem-pc-scheme-derived-mate-evaluation]. Then p(f,g) at Q((fg)_*K), followed by L(fg)*(beta(fg)_K) and a(fg).counit at QK, equals Lf*(epsilon(g)_M followed by Q(b(g).counit_H)), followed by epsilon(f)_H and Q(b(f).counit_K). The common expression is the concrete morphism named in [def-sc-derived-composition-counit-apex].

source.place: Tags 079W, 0D5S and 0D5T; counit normalization subcalculation in lem-sc-derived-pullback-composition-mate-unit. Official tag pages read online on 2026-10-14.

proof.text: Apply the pinned Hom normalization to the composite underived counit. The right triangle identity makes its adjunct the identity. Apply the inverse Hom equivalence to get L(fg)(beta(fg)) followed by its derived counit equal to epsilon(fg) followed by the localized underived counit. This reuses the existing private generic counit_of_normalization helper from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.DerivedDirectImagePastedCounitNormalization via import all; no duplicate helper is declared.

Precompose the resulting equality with the selected pullback comparison using congrArg, then combine it by transitivity with the localized counit composition calculation identifying the result with derivedCompositionCounitApex.

proof_origin.note: Repair: respect transparency in type comparisons, keep the selected adjunction locally irreducible, and open it explicitly only for the pinned Hom equation. Prove the Hom normalization, precompose by congrArg, and leave the strictly smaller left-derived lift and underived mate calculation. Second reading: retain the direct dependencies supplying the chosen underived adjunction and left-derived counit, which the main proof explicitly uses. Repair of X-a4893 return: remove the duplicate local helper and reuse the existing private counit_of_normalization through import all, keeping its call unchanged.

mathlib_searches.results: Generic derived counit and unit factorization results, including Adjunction.derivedε_fac_app; none states the pinned scheme composition calculation.
Adjunction.comp_counit_app and conjugateEquiv_counit_symm supply formal identities; no exact pinned normalization.

Grep of Mathlib/CategoryTheory finds Adjunction.comp_counit_app, conjugateEquiv_counit_symm and derivedε_fac_app. They give generic identities, but no explicit pinned scheme normalization. Also searched lean/Sheaf, lean/WeilConjectures and dag/nodes/sec-picard-framework.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedPullbackComposition_counit_normalization
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    (canonicalDerivedPullbackComposition f g).hom.app
        (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f ≫ g).toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).obj K) ≫
      (derivedPullback (f ≫ g)).map
        ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f ≫ g).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K) ≫
      (schemeHomPullbackAdjunction (f ≫ g)).counit.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
      derivedCompositionCounitApex f g K
